A setting that takes several targets: a queue with three consumers. The second read stopped after the first page of the list and states one consumer. M2 looks at one element at a time, so the edges to the two consumers that the read did not reach keep the evidence of the first read, and nothing leaves the model. The complete record of the first read stays while its evidence does (M3). The third read is complete and states one consumer: now the other two leave (M1, R1, R2).
